name: laestoa.cl
install: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm install 24 && nvm alias default 24 && nvm use 24 && npm ci

terminals.name: wrangler dev
terminals.command: export NVM_DIR="$HOME/.nvm" && . "$NVM_DIR/nvm.sh" && nvm use 24 && npx wrangler dev --ip 127.0.0.1 --port 8787
terminals.description: Local Cloudflare Worker dev server for laestoa.cl on http://127.0.0.1:8787
